framework.primary_law: Bill PL 2338/2023 (AI Legal Framework): passed Senate December 2024, pending in Chamber of Deputies
framework.enforcing_body: Proposed National AI Regulation and Governance System (SIA); ANPD enforces LGPD
framework.max_penalty: Proposed: up to R$50 million per infraction
framework.geographic_scope: Proposed to cover AI developed or used in Brazil.

research_layer.summary: Brazil's PL 2338/2023, modelled on the EU AI Act, would set risk tiers (unacceptable, high, lower), rights to explanation and contestation, and a national governance system with fines up to R$50 million. The Senate approved it unanimously in December 2024; in the Chamber a special committee has held hearings but, as of August 2026, awaited the rapporteur's report after at least four missed vote dates. Scores here reflect protections currently in force, mainly the LGPD data protection law.

key_provisions.title: Rights of affected persons (proposed)
key_provisions.description: Transparency, explanation and contestation for people affected by AI decisions.

key_provisions.title: LGPD data protection
key_provisions.description: Rights over personal data, including review of automated decisions, in force.

cross_jurisdiction_tensions.tension: The bill mirrors the EU model but lacks its enforcement timeline; companies may face EU rules first.

safety_risk_management.rationale: No binding AI risk framework in force.

privacy_data_protection.rationale: LGPD provides strong data protection including automated decision review.

human_oversight.rationale: Right to review automated decisions under LGPD.

accountability.rationale: ANPD enforces data law; no AI regulator yet.

gaps_and_weaknesses: The AI bill has repeatedly missed vote deadlines.
research_layer.monitor_notes: Monitor Chamber special committee progress and any effect of the 2026 election calendar. Scores are provisional AI-drafted judgements against the AIETHOS rubric and reflect protections currently in force.

citizen_layer.one_line: Brazil is close to passing an EU-style AI law but it has stalled in Congress; for now privacy law is the main protection.
citizen_layer.what_changed: The Senate passed an AI law in 2024, but the lower house has not voted. Until it does, data protection law is what protects you.
citizen_layer.who_is_protected: People in Brazil through LGPD and consumer law.
who_is_not_protected: People affected by AI harms not covered by data or consumer law

your_rights.what_it_means: The LGPD lets you request review of decisions made solely by automated processing.
your_rights.how_to_invoke: Write to the company's data protection officer; complain to the ANPD.

citizen_layer.plain_language_summary: Brazil's big AI law is still waiting for a vote. Privacy law helps in the meantime.
